observations: Photo 0 shows a white Xbox One S console with a white controller in front of it, placed on a wooden surface.
Photo 1 shows the same white Xbox One S console with two controllers: one white and one black, placed on a pink fabric surface.
The console has a textured front panel with a circular vent and a visible disc slot.
The controller in photo 0 is white with black analog sticks and buttons, matching the console's color.
The controller in photo 1 is black with colored buttons (red, blue, green, yellow) and a white analog stick.
The console has a small 'X' logo on the front left side, visible in photo 1.
No games or accessories (like power cable, HDMI cable, or stand) are visible in either photo.
The seller claims 'games on it' and 'all the accessories', but no games or additional accessories are shown.

identity.kind: Xbox One S console with one controller

claims.claim: Xbox one s console with one controller
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the console and one controller, matching the description.
No games are visible in either photo. The console's screen or disc drive is not shown, and no games are present. Cannot verify from photos alone.
No power cable, HDMI cable, or stand are visible in either photo. The claim is not supported by the images.
